name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Luna goes with neither Rios nor Geologist.
Between Geologist and Technician, one goes with Fontaine and the other with Luna.
Eklund goes with neither Medic nor Pilot.
Either Callisto goes with Rios or Navigator goes with Anders.
Pilot goes with at least one of Eklund, Luna, or Titan.
If Technician does not go with Callisto, then Fontaine goes with Ganymede.
Earth goes with Anders if and only if Callisto does not go with Eklund.
Callisto goes with either Geologist or Navigator.
